```{r Test dataset for embedding triplet losses, eval = FALSE}
# Rebuilds the triplet test set from the master tables (unseeded). Not run by default:
# the chunks below read the shipped set, embedding-comparison/triplet_embedding_test_set_igblast.csv.

# goal here is to get a relatively small sample of ideally antigen adapted sequences across covid, ms, and healthy pre 2020 from multiple studies
# critical that triplet loss is calculated across studies, we don't want to be picking up technical similarity
# also need to include protein sequences because ESM2 and antiberty are PLMs

read_csv(data_path("metadata/allOPIGdefinedUnpairedMetadata.csv")) %>%
  filter(Disease %in% c('CMV','Dengue','EBV','HCV','HIV','Light-Chain-Amyloidosis','MuSK-MG','None','POEMS','SARS-COV-2','SLE','CLL','Ebola','AChR-MG','MS')) %>%
  mutate(Disease = if_else(Disease == 'None', 'Healthy', Disease)) %>% #prevent pandas issues
  mutate(Year = as.numeric(str_extract(Author, "\\d{4}"))) %>%
  select(file_name, Author, Year, Age, BSource, BType, Disease, Subject, Isotype) -> df

opig <-
  vroom(data_path("sequences/master-opig-dataset-sequence.csv")) %>%
  select(file_name, v_call, sequence, junction, consensus_count, productive, complete_vdj, v_identity) %>%
  filter(productive == T) %>%
  filter(complete_vdj == T) %>%
  filter(v_identity < 95) %>%
  filter(consensus_count > 2) %>%
  filter(str_starts(v_call, "IGH")) %>%
  right_join(df, by = 'file_name') %>%
  filter(!is.na(sequence), !is.na(Disease)) %>%
  filter(Disease %in% c('SARS-COV-2', 'MuSK-MG', 'AChR-MG', 'SLE') | (Disease == 'Healthy' & Year < 2020)) %>%
  ungroup()

read_metadata() %>%
  select(Run, BioProject, create_date, Tissue, `Cell Type`, Age, Sex, DonorID, Disease, `Disease Class`, Treatment, `Patient State`, EDSS, `Years disease`) -> metadata

trust4 <- 
  vroom(data_path("sequences/master-trust4-dataset-sequence.csv")) %>%
  filter(productive == T) %>%
  filter(complete_vdj == T) %>%
  filter(v_identity < 95) %>%
  filter(consensus_count > 2) %>%
  filter(str_starts(v_call, "IGH")) %>%
  mutate(SRA = str_extract(file_name, "(SRR|ERR)[0-9]+")) %>%
  left_join(metadata, by = c('SRA' = 'Run')) %>%
  filter(!is.na(sequence), !is.na(Disease))

# Filter starting dataset
trust4 <- 
  trust4 %>%
  mutate(Year = year(create_date)) %>%
  mutate(Disease = if_else(Disease %in% c('Healthy','Control'), 'Healthy', Disease)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Author = BioProject) %>%
  dplyr::rename(BSource = Tissue) %>%
  dplyr::rename(BType = `Cell Type`) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Isotype = c_call) %>%
  mutate(Subject = paste(Age, Sex, DonorID)) %>%
  filter((Disease == 'Multiple sclerosis' & BSource == 'CSF') | (Disease == 'Healthy' & Year < 2020)) %>%
  ungroup()

library(igblastr)
#install_IMGT_germline_db('202531-1')
use_germline_db("IMGT-202531-1.Homo_sapiens.IGH+IGK+IGL")
use_c_region_db("_IMGT.human.IGH+IGK+IGL.202412")

list(opig, trust4) %>%
  map(select, 'sequence', 'Author', 'Disease', 'Subject') %>%
  purrr::reduce(rbind) %>%
  group_by(Author, Disease, Subject) %>%
  slice_sample(n = 2000) -> embedding_ds
  
seqs <- DNAStringSet(embedding_ds$sequence)
names(seqs) <- rep(1, nrow(embedding_ds))

# Run igblastn
igblast_results <- 
  igblastn(
  query = seqs,
  organism = "human",
  outfmt = "AIRR",
  num_threads=16,
  num_alignments_V=1,
  num_alignments_C=1
)
 
igblast_results %>%
  mutate(sequence = str_sub(sequence, v_sequence_start, j_sequence_end)) %>%
  select(sequence, sequence_aa) %>%
  bind_cols(embedding_ds[c('Author','Disease','Subject')])

# Re-igblast to trim amino acids to trimmed sequence
```

```{r Fig 2C cosine similarity}
set.seed(42)
library(tidyverse)
library(matrixStats)

cosine_sim <- function(A, B) {
  if (!all(dim(A) == dim(B))) stop("A and B must have the same dimensions")
  numer <- rowSums2(A * B)
  denom <- sqrt(rowSums2(A^2)) * sqrt(rowSums2(B^2))
  numer / denom
}

inputs <- read_csv(data_path("embedding-comparison/triplet_embedding_test_set_igblast.csv"))
mistral_embeddings        <- read_csv(out_path("embeddings/mistral-meanpooled-embeddings.csv"))
esm2_embeddings <- read_csv(out_path("embeddings/esm2-meanpooled-embeddings.csv"))
abroberta <- read_csv(out_path("embeddings/abroberta-meanpooled-embeddings.csv"))


### Mistral ###
bind_cols(inputs, mistral_embeddings) %>%
  group_by(Disease) %>%
  slice_sample(n = 10000, replace = T) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  slice_sample(n = 75000) -> mistral1
matrix1 <- as.matrix(mistral1[7:ncol(mistral1)])

bind_cols(inputs, mistral_embeddings) %>%
  group_by(Disease) %>%
  slice_sample(n = 10000, replace = T) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  slice_sample(n = 75000) -> mistral2
matrix2 <- as.matrix(mistral2[7:ncol(mistral2)])

similarities_mistral <-
  cosine_sim(matrix1, matrix2)

bind_cols(mistral1[3:6], mistral2[3:6]) %>%
  mutate(similarity = similarities_mistral) %>%
  filter(Disease...2 != 'Healthy' | Disease...6 != 'Healthy') %>% # remove healthy-healthy comparisons, not meaningful
  #mutate(disease_study_match = if_else((Disease...2 == Disease...6 & Author...1 != Author...5), 'disease match, across study', 'other')) %>%
  #mutate(disease_study_match = if_else((Disease...2 != Disease...6 & Author...1 != Author...5), 'disease mismatch, across study', disease_study_match)) %>%
  mutate(disease_study_match = if_else((Disease...2 == Disease...6 & Subject...3 != Subject...7), 'disease match, across patients', 'other')) %>%
  mutate(disease_study_match = if_else((Disease...2 != Disease...6 & Subject...3 != Subject...7), 'disease mismatch, across patients', disease_study_match)) %>%
  #mutate(normalized_similarity = (similarity - mean(similarity[disease_study_match == 'disease mismatch, across study']))) %>%
  mutate(normalized_similarity = (similarity - mean(similarity[disease_study_match == 'disease mismatch, across patients'])) / sd(similarity[disease_study_match == 'disease mismatch, across patients'])) %>%
  mutate(model = 'bcr-mistral') -> mistral

#######

  mutate(disease_study_match = if_else((Disease...2 == Disease...6 & Subject...3 != Subject...7), 'disease match, across patients', 'other')) %>%

  #mutate(normalized_similarity = (similarity - mean(similarity[disease_study_match == 'disease mismatch, across study']))) %>%

p_cosine <- bind_rows(mistral, abroberta, esm2) %>%
  #filter(Disease...2 == 'Multiple sclerosis' | Disease...6 == 'Multiple sclerosis') %>%
  #filter(Disease...2 == 'SARS-COV-2' | Disease...6 == 'SARS-COV-2') %>%
  #filter(Disease...2 == 'Healthy' | Disease...6 == 'Healthy') %>%
  #filter(Disease...2 != 'Healthy' & Disease...6 != 'Healthy') %>%
  filter(disease_study_match != 'other') %>%
  filter(disease_study_match != 'disease mismatch, across patients') %>%
  group_by(model, disease_study_match) %>%
  summarize(boot_mean = replicate(100, mean(sample(normalized_similarity, replace = T))), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(disease_study_match = fct_rev(disease_study_match)) %>%
  mutate(model = fct_reorder(model, boot_mean, max)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = model, y = boot_mean, fill = disease_study_match)) +
  geom_boxplot(outliers = F, notch = T) +
  labs(y = 'Mean Z Scored Cosine Similarity', x = "") +
  scale_fill_viridis_d() +
  theme_linedraw(base_size = 8) +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1,
        legend.position = 'none')   # one group (disease match across patients), as in the paper
p_cosine
```

```{r Triplet rank - accuracy}

library(tidyverse)
library(Rfast)
library(glue)

triplet_accuracy <- function(
  embeddings_csv,
  metadata_csv,
  n_triplets = 5000,
  distance = c("cosine", "euclidean")
) {
  distance <- match.arg(distance)
  
  message("Loading data...")
  emb <- read_csv(embeddings_csv, show_col_types = FALSE)
  meta <- read_csv(metadata_csv, show_col_types = FALSE)
  
  # Ensure same number of rows
  stopifnot(nrow(meta) == nrow(emb))
  df <- bind_cols(meta, emb)
  
  stopifnot(all(c("Disease", "Subject") %in% colnames(df)))
  
  X <- df %>% select(starts_with("hidden_state_")) %>% as.matrix()
  diseases <- df$Disease
  authors <- df$Subject
  unique_diseases <- unique(diseases)
  
  # balanced sampling per Disease
  n_per_class <- ceiling(n_triplets / length(unique_diseases))
  set.seed(123)
  
  message("Sampling anchors with replacement (balanced by Disease)...")
  triplets <- map_dfr(unique_diseases, function(d) {
    anchor_idx <- which(diseases == d)
    if (length(anchor_idx) < 2) return(tibble())
    
    # sample anchors with replacement
    sampled_anchors <- sample(anchor_idx, n_per_class, replace = TRUE)
    
    tibble(
      anchor = sampled_anchors,
      positive = map_int(sampled_anchors, function(a_idx) {
        candidates <- which(diseases == d & authors != authors[a_idx])
        if (length(candidates) == 0) return(NA_integer_)
        sample(candidates, 1)
      }),
      negative = map_int(sampled_anchors, function(a_idx) {
        candidates <- which(diseases != d & authors != authors[a_idx])
        if (length(candidates) == 0) return(NA_integer_)
        sample(candidates, 1)
      }),
      disease = d
    )
  })
  
  triplets <- triplets %>% drop_na()
  message(glue("Using {nrow(triplets)} valid triplets after filtering."))
  
  if (nrow(triplets) == 0) {
    stop("No valid triplets found given your constraints.")
  }
  
  message("Computing distances...")
  anchor_emb <- X[triplets$anchor, , drop = FALSE]
  pos_emb    <- X[triplets$positive, , drop = FALSE]
  neg_emb    <- X[triplets$negative, , drop = FALSE]
  
  if (distance == "euclidean") {
    d_pos <- sqrt(rowSums((anchor_emb - pos_emb)^2))
    d_neg <- sqrt(rowSums((anchor_emb - neg_emb)^2))
  } else {  # cosine
    normalize <- function(m) m / sqrt(rowSums(m^2))
    A <- normalize(anchor_emb)
    P <- normalize(pos_emb)
    N <- normalize(neg_emb)
    d_pos <- 1 - rowSums(A * P)
    d_neg <- 1 - rowSums(A * N)
  }
  
  correct <- d_neg / d_pos #d_pos < d_neg
  triplets$correct <- correct
  
  acc <- mean(correct)
  per_class <- triplets %>%
    group_by(disease) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), accuracy = mean(correct), .groups = "drop")
  
  message(glue("Overall triplet accuracy: {round(acc * 100, 2)}%"))
  print(per_class)
  
  invisible(list(
    overall_accuracy = acc,
    per_class = per_class,
    triplets = triplets
  ))
}

resRoberta <- triplet_accuracy(
  embeddings_csv = out_path("embeddings/abroberta-meanpooled-embeddings.csv"),
  metadata_csv   = data_path("embedding-comparison/triplet_embedding_test_set_igblast.csv"),
  n_triplets = 50000,
  distance = "euclidean"
)
resRoberta <-
  resRoberta$triplets %>%
  mutate(model = 'ab-roberta')

resEsm2 <- triplet_accuracy(
  embeddings_csv = out_path("embeddings/esm2-meanpooled-embeddings.csv"),
  metadata_csv   = data_path("embedding-comparison/triplet_embedding_test_set_igblast.csv"),
  n_triplets = 50000,
  distance = "euclidean"
)
resEsm2 <-
  resEsm2$triplets %>%
  mutate(model = 'esm2-650m')

resMistral <- triplet_accuracy(
  embeddings_csv = out_path("embeddings/mistral-meanpooled-embeddings.csv"),
  metadata_csv = data_path("embedding-comparison/triplet_embedding_test_set_igblast.csv"),
  n_triplets = 50000,
  distance = "euclidean"
)
resMistral <-
  resMistral$triplets %>%
  mutate(model = 'bcr-mistral')

list(resMistral, resEsm2, resRoberta) %>%
  purrr::reduce(bind_rows) %>%
  group_by(model) %>% #disease
  summarize(mean_accuracy = replicate(100, mean(sample(correct, replace = T))), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(model = fct_reorder(model, mean_accuracy, mean)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = mean_accuracy, fill = model, x = model)) +
  geom_boxplot(outliers = F) +
  #facet_wrap(vars(disease)) +
  theme_linedraw(base_size = 8) +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1,
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = 'none') +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1) +
  labs(x = "", y = "Neg. Distance / Pos. Distance")

FIGURES_DIR <- out_path("figures")
dir.create(FIGURES_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "fig2C_embedding_comparison_triplet.svg"), width = 2.5, height = 2.5)
```

```{r 300M plm and universified models}
# The models the paper called 300M hold 151M parameters (counted from their config); the labels
# below say 151m. The chunk after this one repeats the comparison for the 304M replications.
set.seed(42)
library(tidyverse)
library(matrixStats)

cosine_sim <- function(A, B) {
  if (!all(dim(A) == dim(B))) stop("A and B must have the same dimensions")
  numer <- rowSums2(A * B)
  denom <- sqrt(rowSums2(A^2)) * sqrt(rowSums2(B^2))
  numer / denom
}

inputs <- read_csv(data_path("embedding-comparison/triplet_embedding_test_set_igblast.csv"))
mistral_300m_embeddings   <- read_csv(out_path("embeddings/mistral-meanpooled-embeddings-300M.csv"))
mistral_300m_undiv_embeddings <- read_csv(out_path("embeddings/mistral-meanpooled-embeddings-300M-undiversified.csv"))
mistral_plm_embeddings        <- read_csv(out_path("embeddings/mistral-meanpooled-embeddings-protein.csv"))

### bcr-mistral-300m ###
bind_cols(inputs, mistral_300m_embeddings) %>%
  group_by(Disease) %>%
  slice_sample(n = 10000, replace = T) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  slice_sample(n = 75000) -> mistral_300m_1
matrix1 <- as.matrix(mistral_300m_1[7:ncol(mistral_300m_1)])

bind_cols(inputs, mistral_300m_embeddings) %>%
  group_by(Disease) %>%
  slice_sample(n = 10000, replace = T) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  slice_sample(n = 75000) -> mistral_300m_2
matrix2 <- as.matrix(mistral_300m_2[7:ncol(mistral_300m_2)])

similarities_mistral_300m <-
  cosine_sim(matrix1, matrix2)

bind_cols(mistral_300m_1[3:6], mistral_300m_2[3:6]) %>%
  mutate(similarity = similarities_mistral_300m) %>%
  filter(Disease...2 != 'Healthy' | Disease...6 != 'Healthy') %>%
  mutate(disease_study_match = if_else((Disease...2 == Disease...6 & Subject...3 != Subject...7), 'disease match, across patients', 'other')) %>%
  mutate(disease_study_match = if_else((Disease...2 != Disease...6 & Subject...3 != Subject...7), 'disease mismatch, across patients', disease_study_match)) %>%
  mutate(normalized_similarity = (similarity - mean(similarity[disease_study_match == 'disease mismatch, across patients'])) / sd(similarity[disease_study_match == 'disease mismatch, across patients'])) %>%
  mutate(model = 'bcr-mistral-151m') -> mistral_300m

  mutate(disease_study_match = fct_rev(disease_study_match)) %>%
  mutate(model = fct_reorder(model, boot_mean, max)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = model, y = boot_mean, fill = disease_study_match)) +
  geom_boxplot(outliers = F, notch = T) +
  labs(y = 'Mean Z Scored Cosine Similarity', x = "") +
  scale_fill_viridis_d() +
  theme_linedraw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1,
        legend.position = 'bottom')


FIGURES_DIR <- out_path("figures")
dir.create(FIGURES_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "figS1A_embedding_comparison_300M_variants.svg"), width = 2.5, height = 2.5)
  
```

```{r S1A with correctly sized 304M models, eval = file.exists(out_path("embeddings/mistral-meanpooled-embeddings-300M-1024x20.csv"))}
# Same procedure as the chunk above, for the correctly sized 304M models
# (foundation-models/train_300M*_1024x20.py; embeddings/extract_mistral_1024x20_pooled.py).
set.seed(42)
z_scored_similarity <- function(embeddings, model_name) {
  draw <- function() bind_cols(inputs, embeddings) %>%
    group_by(Disease) %>% slice_sample(n = 10000, replace = T) %>% ungroup() %>% slice_sample(n = 75000)
  a <- draw(); b <- draw()
  bind_cols(a[3:6], b[3:6]) %>%
    mutate(similarity = cosine_sim(as.matrix(a[7:ncol(a)]), as.matrix(b[7:ncol(b)]))) %>%
    filter(Disease...2 != 'Healthy' | Disease...6 != 'Healthy') %>%
    mutate(disease_study_match = if_else((Disease...2 == Disease...6 & Subject...3 != Subject...7), 'disease match, across patients', 'other')) %>%
    mutate(disease_study_match = if_else((Disease...2 != Disease...6 & Subject...3 != Subject...7), 'disease mismatch, across patients', disease_study_match)) %>%
    mutate(normalized_similarity = (similarity - mean(similarity[disease_study_match == 'disease mismatch, across patients'])) / sd(similarity[disease_study_match == 'disease mismatch, across patients'])) %>%
    mutate(model = model_name)
}

sized <- c(`bcr-mistral-304m` = "300M-1024x20", `bcr-mistral-304m-undiv` = "300M-1024x20-undiversified",
           `bcr-mistral-304m-plm` = "300M-1024x20-protein")
sized <- sized[file.exists(out_path(paste0("embeddings/mistral-meanpooled-embeddings-", sized, ".csv")))]
sized_similarities <- imap(sized, ~ z_scored_similarity(read_csv(out_path(paste0("embeddings/mistral-meanpooled-embeddings-", .x, ".csv"))), .y))

bind_rows(sized_similarities) %>%
  filter(disease_study_match == 'disease match, across patients') %>%
  group_by(model) %>%
  summarize(boot_mean = replicate(1000, mean(sample(normalized_similarity, replace = T))), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(model = fct_reorder(model, boot_mean, max)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = model, y = boot_mean)) +
  geom_boxplot(outliers = F, notch = T, fill = viridisLite::viridis(1)) +
  labs(y = 'Mean Z Scored Cosine Similarity', x = "") +
  theme_linedraw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(aspect.ratio = 1, axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

ggsave(file.path(FIGURES_DIR, "figS1A_embedding_comparison_300M_variants_sized.svg"), width = 2.5, height = 2.5)
```
